method.pairs: literature/dft_parity.json default subset; literature DFT vs median experiment of the same compound

chemistry_classes.metal: all-metal intermetallic (none of the elements below)
chemistry_classes.pblock_anion: contains a p-block / anion element (H, B, C, N, O, F, Si, P, S, Se, Te, As, Sb, halogens)
chemistry_classes.magnetic_3d: contains Cr, Mn, Fe, Co or Ni (and no p-block / anion element)

match_quality.on_hull_single: DFT entry on the hull and the only entry at its composition
match_quality.polymorph_ambiguous: on the hull, several entries (polymorphs) at the composition
match_quality.above_hull: lowest DFT entry at the composition lies above the hull
